correctness.rationale: For every integer \(n\ge1\), reduction to its odd part and power-of-two exponent is exhaustive. Merca Theorem 1.1 supplies exact coefficients. The local congruence \(\sigma(p^e)-\lambda(p^e)\equiv4\mathbf{1}_{p\equiv3,5\ (\mathrm{mod}\ 8)}\lceil e/2\rceil\pmod8\) is proved in all four odd-prime residue classes. Multiplicativity yields a parity sum with all but at most one odd exponent suppressed. The dyadic correction toggles precisely odd-square parts. The asymptotic isolates the \(j=0\) stratum; square terms, higher prime exponents, and excluded \(p\mid r\) cost \(O(\sqrt X)\). The prime number theorem modulo eight and dominated convergence yield \(\pi^2/8\). Bounded signed enumeration and local prime-power congruence checks agree, but do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete parity classification for the extant signed two-block odd partition function, with a quadratic-character square component and a single distinguished-prime branch. The exact \(\pi^2X/(8\log X)\) count quantifies unexpectedly sparse infinite support and connects signed partitions to prime-distribution asymptotics, rather than merely reproducing a finite numerical table.
